panel_metadata.restriction_reason: Hourly API daily quota reached; only complete weather ZIPs used. Acquisition availability is not random. Original full-sample results remain archived; R00 compares original weather on exactly the revised sample.
panel_metadata.station_rule: Nearest of six existing stations by haversine distance, then <=25 km and <=200 m absolute elevation difference; quality-valid TMAX. Paired models share identical rows.
panel_metadata.holiday_rule: Observed US federal holidays from pandas USFederalHolidayCalendar; proxy for calendar disruptions, not all local holidays/events.
panel_metadata.warning: All inputs are public aggregates. Missing source records are not recoverable from a zero panel. Station day conventions differ from civil dates.

multiplicity: Holm across24 revision tests spanning both outcomes, including paired legacy-weather comparisons; original full-sample families archived separately; intervals individually95%
model_definition: Poisson log mean; ZIP/year-month/weekday effects; daily-score Bartlett HAC7 withN/(N-K); all1461score dates retained; normal intervals
